The derivation up to  
\[
\sqrt{\log_2 P}= \frac{832038}{\sqrt{\log_2 3}}
\]  
is correct, but the crucial step “\(\log_2 3 = 2\)” is false (actually \(\log_2 3\approx1.58496\)). Consequently the numeric evaluation \(588333\) is wrong; the correct value is \(832038\sqrt{\log_3 2}\approx6.61\times10^5\), not an integer.

**VERDICT: REJECT**
